audience: marketing teams that use WisePops pop-ups on a website to collect contacts

useCases.title: Compare pop-up results
useCases.text: List your pop-ups with their activation state, and their display, click and email counts.

useCases.title: Export contacts collected since a date
useCases.text: List the contacts your pop-ups collected after a UTC date. Each contact shows its collection time, pop-up ID, IP and country.

useCases.title: Match contacts to their pop-up
useCases.text: Find a pop-up ID in the pop-up list, then list only the contacts that pop-up collected.
